# Operator Phase Approval: Phase 07 Shared MCP Core and Governed ChatGPT Role Integration

Status: approved
Project: ChampCity A/I
Phase: phase-07 — Architect Bridge and MCP-First Integration
Decision: Phase Planning revision 2 and Work Card Plan revision 1 approved

The Operator approved the Phase 07 planning direction and ordered Work Card sequence.

Approved authority:

- `champcity-ai/phase-07/phase_planning/Phase_Planning`, revision 2, payload hash `sha256:f141e4c1118aa9f988581c53e0c8a2228f2ece1fc55993fcef00e0ca958df648`
- `champcity-ai/phase-07/work_card_plan/Work_Card_Plan`, revision 1, payload hash `sha256:4c2640e79bcc267ac945daee6e16b12054bac894ec88e88eff1e73ba2bf5c585`

This approval authorizes the Architect to create the just-in-time WC01 planning/review Work Card:

`champcity-ai/phase-07/work_card/WC01`

This approval does not authorize source-code implementation, shared repository creation, package publication, extraction, embedding, or role execution. WC01 must be created and separately approved before its bounded work begins.

WC01 is the required entry gate for:

- the complete ChampCity_GPT portability and extraction review;
- the shared-core architecture contract;
- the role-to-tool and role-to-permission matrix;
- lifecycle and Registry reconciliation;
- the extraction, migration, rollback, and dual-host validation plan.

No later Phase 07 candidate may bypass accepted WC01 evidence.
